I think it's important to consider the consequences of my actions. If I continued the lessons despite Mark's wishes, that might make things worse. He might feel uncomfortable or unsafe around me. So, in this case, stopping the lessons might be the right decision because it prevents further harm and respects Mark's wishes. It's a tricky situation, and I need to weigh the pros and cons carefully.
